abstract: Implemented all three #67 deliverables (dispatches lane filter, trains lane filter, compact-clock time) in board/web, red-first throughout. Terminality for dispatches reads the row's own composed stateRegister (nominal equals returned); trains terminality is derived from declaredNotObserved plus every car's stateRegister since trains carry no top-level liveness field. Shared capTerminalHistory (board/web/js/history-filter.js) never filters a non-terminal row by construction; shared formatClockDuration (board/web/js/format.js) replaces every unit-suffixed duration render board-wide. composeRegister's three-axis composition is untouched, confirmed by dedicated tests. Honesty summary line asserts true hidden-history counts, rendered only when something is actually hidden. Reconciled the pre-existing .solari-rows severity-escape CSS disclosure with the new filter rather than double-reporting. Verified with a real Playwright browser against the real Go server and a new reusable scratch-store fixture (buildScratchStoreWithLaneFilterFixtures), observing all three claims live including a getComputedStyle color match against the nominal register token. Suite counts at commit ae1bd02: board/web node --test 162/162 (base 129/129), Go board/ 85/85 with clean go vet (untouched), Pester scripts/tests 223/227 passed 4 skipped 0 failed (exact baseline match, citation gates green), scripts/probes 24/24, probe-yard-snapshot.mjs PASS. No honest stops; one disclosed optional follow-up (no issue #1 comment posted, not mandated).
